/ʃɛ.ɹi.tʃɛ.ɹi/ — your voice-to-voice finance & business darling.
Connecting…
V13.0 offline-first: Merchant Data + Memory + Customers + Forecasting foundation; English/French continue online/offline where device engines are available; Kinyarwanda offline voice uses the installed platform voice bridge (Android, iPhone/iPad, Windows, or another supported native host) and local merchant data.

Ready.

Tap to start talking with Shericeri.
Voice is language-locked: Shericeri speaks one selected language at a time. English and French use the device speech engine. Kinyarwanda uses online voice generation when connected, with the installed local voice bridge as an offline option where supported.
Sherry-Cherry, at your service — finance, accounting, business intelligence, and the occasional bad pun. Tap the mic and let's talk.
